patch: stopped; results/weights preserved separately; not part of RGCL

score_definition.meaning: LLM confidence that the change fixes a vulnerability; not severity or human confirmation

cleanvul_data.association_rule: released CSV row supplies the before/after association; no parser/name/change-type classification filter
cleanvul_data.label_provenance: score>=3 repair-before target=1 and repair-after target=0; confidence-based repair labels, not manual ground truth

split_protocol.grouping: transitive union of CVE, fix commit, repair link and whitespace-normalized source (including counterparts)
split_protocol.commit_references: repository-qualified shortest observed compatible hash prefix; original commit_id preserved

cleanvul_data.classification_weight_rule: Train negatives / positives; same BCE for all three methods
